coverage.why: Germania has no single-domain calendar the way the other four venues do. Its official COTA page (circuitoftheamericas.com/concerts-at-germania-insurance-amphitheater/) is a description with an out-link, not a listing. The venue's real calendar lives at germaniaamp.com (linked from that COTA page), and it currently lists exactly 4 upcoming shows, the last one Oct 17, 2026 -- nothing between then and 2027-05-31. That is a real, current gap on the venue's own site, not a fetch failure: the page has no 'load more', no pagination, and the HTML plainly ends after the 4th card. TWO complications, both worth flagging for the scorer: (1) germaniaamp.com's HTTPS endpoint hangs and times out on every TLS attempt from this machine (plain HTTP on the same host works and served the real page, so this reads as a server-side TLS misconfiguration on that host rather than a block -- an automated pipeline hitting this venue over HTTPS-only would get nothing and might wrongly conclude the venue has zero events). (2) The site's own 'Buy Tickets' link -- effectively its full box-office calendar -- goes to a Ticketmaster venue page, and Ticketmaster refused a plain, courteous fetch outright (HTTP 403, body {"response":"block"}), even before robots.txt could be checked (robots.txt itself 403'd). So it's plausible Germania has more shows booked for winter/spring that only show up on Ticketmaster and not yet on the venue's own microsite -- this study could not verify that without a browser-grade fetch, which was out of scope for a courtesy read. Recorded coverage.complete=false for exactly that reason: what's here is faithful to germaniaamp.com, but germaniaamp.com itself may be an incomplete picture of the venue's real booking calendar.
